description: An empty argv, which the C contract leaves undefined, yields an empty program name and no arguments in CLASP.Rust.
notes: Candidate to contribute back to the shared corpus. The C function leaves argc less than 1 undefined, so this case is not an oracle result. It locks the Rust stand-in.

provenance.note: Rust-authored. Derived from include/clasp/clasp.h clasp_parseArguments, the precondition that argc must be 1 or more (around the retval lines and the note that argc less than 1 is undefined). CLASP.Rust returns an empty program name and no arguments instead of panicking.
